name: computer_core_2
title: Computer Core 2 (ALPHA)
author: SirEdvin; original Computer Core by Relik77 and contributors
description: EXPERIMENTAL 0.4.1 ALPHA PLAYTEST - native editor save/exit controls and a terminal key selector avoid focused shortcut suppression. Blue computers support a restricted native interactive lua shell, finite saved scripts and owned circuit ports. No arbitrary Lua, loops, modules, VM fallback or world/network access on blue. Original/personal VM computers retain Recrafted. Graphical input/rendering and multiplayer joins remain unverified. Back up saves; never downgrade a migrated save.
